lines.en: I take a step and the ground sinks.

lines.zh: 我的身体有好几段，都在动。
lines.en: My body has several segments, and all of them move.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，留下虚空。
lines.en: Void is left where I've walked.

lines.zh: 空气跟着我，往我这边塌。
lines.en: The air collapses toward me as I go.

lines.zh: 我拖着一片黑，走过裂地。
lines.en: I drag a sheet of darkness across the cracked ground.

lines.zh: 我身上的光，是冷的那种。
lines.en: The light on me is the cold kind.
I walk toward the seals.
Those stones are ringing one by one.
I hear them giving way.
I rear up, very tall.
I stand like a broken pillar.

lines.zh: 我身上有裂缝，里面没有东西。
lines.en: There are cracks in me, with nothing inside.
I have many hands, and all of them hang.
I raise one slowly.
Its shadow on the ground rises too.
The shadow is slower than I am.

lines.zh: 我听见很远的地方有哭声。
lines.en: I hear crying, a long way off.
I made that, once.
I don't much care now.
I'm waiting for the seals to loosen.
They've been loosening all along.
Only very slowly.
I have all the time; I count slowly.
I've never lacked time.
Light slides off me.
It never reaches the ground.
You're standing inside the seal.
Those stones ring you.
They ring me too.
I lift myself out of the seal.
And you stand straight.

lines.zh: 我记得有个人也这样站。
lines.en: I remember someone standing like that.
He shut me in here.
He isn't here now.
Do you want to try too?
The stones will ring first.
You heard the stones.

lines.zh: 封印的石头一块块亮起。
lines.en: The seal stones light up one by one.
Another sky churns inside the missing piece.
The gap doesn't close.
That made me lean back.
I brace myself back up.

lines.zh: 封印的裂缝又撕开了一寸。
lines.en: The seal's crack tore open another inch.

lines.zh: 碎片落进虚空，没有声音。
lines.en: Fragments fall into the void without a sound.

lines.zh: 掉下去的东西，没有落地。
lines.en: It never reached the ground.

lines.zh: 虚空替我收下了这一下。
lines.en: The void absorbed that for me.
I haven't felt pain in a long time.
You've reminded me a little.
You have something bright in your hand.

lines.zh: 我要的是解开封印的东西。
lines.en: What I want is what unbinds the seal.

lines.zh: 你手里的光，引不开我的锁。
lines.en: The light in your hand cannot pick my lock.
Like the key to the seal.
The key isn't on you.
Then it's useless.
The seal broke. I wake.
You edged back a step.
You backed off fast. Clever.
But the stones ring you.
You hit me and are thrown back.
You hit a cold, hard blackness.
Now there's black on your hands.
That black won't wash off.
A long trench splits open under my foot.
You jump aside.
You jumped well enough.
But this ground has thinned.
I turn back, dragging void with me.
You're still in the ring.
I was locked away.
I wasn't born.
I'm the only one left inside the seal.
There used to be others.
The seals ate them.
One of us is left inside the seal.
Because I'm bigger.
I don't much want to talk about it.
Put the question away.
Let's get back to business.
I don't pick things up.

lines.zh: 我的手一松，它就悬住了。
lines.en: I open my hand and it hangs there.
And it floats up.
Turning in my palm.

lines.zh: 封印一破，我就站起来了。
lines.en: Break the seal and I rise.
It starts to go black.
Then it breaks into pieces.
The pieces land on me.
I shake the fragments off.
They never reach the ground.
There's a split in the seal.

lines.zh: 封印上那道缝，我看见了。
lines.en: I see that split in the seal.
Reach: a hundred paces.
I lift one of my arms.
The stones on the ground lift.
They circle me.

lines.zh: 你的火光在我眼里很小。
lines.en: Your torchlight looks tiny to me.

lines.zh: 你站在第三块石头旁边。
lines.en: You're beside the third stone.
That stone has already cracked.
I turn that way.
At last you're running.
Run. I'm counting.
I've done this part many times.
It's about the same every time.
You're faster than the last one.
He made seven steps.
Let's see how many you manage.
You've made the eighth step.

lines.zh: 封印碎了，我从虚空里出来。
lines.en: The seal broke; I come out of the void.

lines.zh: 我的封印一破，虚空就开。
lines.en: My seal breaks, and the void opens.
That stone is mine.

lines.zh: 我一抬手，它就飘起来了。
lines.en: I raise a hand and it floats up.
You're out in the open.
You flatten yourself to the ground.
The ground begins to split.
The split follows you.
You jumped the split.
And jump again.

lines.zh: 你踩过的地面开始下陷。
lines.en: The ground sinks where you have stepped.
Your fingers have slackened on your weapon.

lines.zh: 封印的铁还钉在我肩里。
lines.en: The seal's iron is still nailed into my shoulder.
The seal is still on me.
A little looser and it'll be different.
The ring of stones hums beneath your feet.
The void opens behind me.
The stones are ringing together.
One has broken.
Another stone of the seal breaks.

lines.zh: 虚空顺着我的掌心砸落。
lines.en: The void pours down through my palm.
The ground caves into a crater.
You're not in it.
You rolled clear.
Three stones hang above you.
Three this time.
They come down from three sides.
You dodge two.
The third grazes you.
You can't hold and go down on one knee.
I lower myself slowly.
My body blocks half the sky.
You lift your head and look at me.

lines.zh: 我俯身，影子盖住整片地。
lines.en: I lean down and my shadow covers the whole floor.

lines.zh: 封印上出现了一道裂纹。
lines.en: A crack appears in the seal.
It spreads down to the ground.
The stones loosen one by one.
The seal broke. I reach out a hand first.
It shoves the stones aside.

lines.zh: 肩膀先从裂口里挤出来。
lines.en: My shoulder squeezes out of the rift first.
I push up out of the earth.

lines.zh: 土落在我身上，又浮起来。
lines.en: Soil falls on me and floats up again.
The light here is brighter than inside.
I'm not used to it.

lines.zh: 我把手抬起来遮了一下。
lines.en: I raise a hand to shade myself.
My shadow blocks it.
Much better.
I see the ring of stones.
The ring of stones is still there.
A few of them don't work anymore.
I walk over, dragging void with me.

lines.zh: 脚下的地，一块块往下沉。
lines.en: The ground sinks under each step.
I stop outside the ring.
It isn't fully open yet.
Fire won't catch on me.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下来，把一个坑加深了。
lines.en: I fall from height and deepen a crater.

lines.zh: 水一碰到我，就变成虚空。
lines.en: Water turns to void where it touches me.

lines.zh: 炸响把我的一只手炸散了。
lines.en: The blast scatters one of my hands.

lines.zh: 箭进到我身体里，就没有了。
lines.en: An arrow goes into me and is gone.

lines.zh: 这道咒是封印的一部分。
lines.en: That spell is part of the seal.
The seal keeps everything out.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我把它吃了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me, and I swallow it.

lines.zh: 这里我熟，我本来就从这儿来。
lines.en: I know this place. This is where I come from.
